data.name: Bihar Ganga floods (Sultanganj - Bhagalpur reach)

period.reported: 4-23 Sep (Ganga above danger mark at Bhagalpur)

data.cause: Ganga river flood (above the danger mark at Bhagalpur); much of the water came from rain upstream, outside the box
notes: River flood: this flood was driven by the river, so much of the water came from rain upstream, outside this box. Rain over the box shows only the local part.
